title: migrate(value-shapes): option fields keep old raw number/boolean and SQLite "N.0" rows after #29562; scan and rewrite to the declared code
body:
domain:server#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQjPiXgNoSaEpqeGvY

立卡门类别: ① 产品缺陷 — 具名落点 (read from source). Follow-up S3 of contract review issuecomment-6591249009 on PR #29638 (#29562), OQ2 answered A: its own card.
reach: rows written to an option-family field (`select`, `radio`, `multiselect`, `checkboxes`, `tags`, the rest of `MULTI_OPTION_TYPES`) before PR #29638 lands.
业务理由: after #29562 a new write stores `3` as `"3"`, but an old row keeps the form the driver stored: driver-memory with persistence holds a raw `3` / `true`, and SQLite holds the TEXT `"3.0"` / `"1.0"` / `"0.0"` (a JS number bound as REAL into a TEXT column). So `{ f: "3" }` misses old rows, a read hands back the old form, and on a unique field a new `"3"` does not collide with an old `"3.0"`. This is the posture #29241 accepted for the text family until a migration exists.
动手的读者: `domain:server` (the `os migrate value-shapes` family, #29431). Triage grades it; the seat suggests p3.
查重: `migrate value-shapes option select` → 0 open covering it; nearest #29431 (value-shapes scan, reference + structured JSON only) and #29241 (text-family twin, no stored-row card).

## What happens on main

- `isScannableValueShapeField` covers the reference and structured-JSON classes only, so the scan cannot see an option field.
- A SQLite `"3.0"` is decidable only against declared codes: it means `"3"` when `"3"` is a declared code, and nothing can be said on a free select. A memory-persisted raw `3` is decidable by type.

## Wanted

1. Measure first: on SQLite and driver-memory, write rows on base, upgrade, and report what a read, a filter and a unique insert answer.
2. Extend the scan to option fields: a raw number or boolean becomes `String(value)`; a SQLite `"N.0"` / `"1.0"` / `"0.0"` is rewritten to the declared code it matches, and reported, not rewritten, on a free field. Dry run first, as the family does.
3. Say whether the text family (#29241) needs the same pass, and either fold it in or name its card.

**Level:** a migration the operator runs; no write-door change. Expect `Clause-②: no`.
